params.name: role
params.description: Definition of the role the `participatingOrganization` plays (Select OrganizationAffiliations with the specified role)

params.name: specialty
params.description: Specific specialty of the `participatingOrganization` in the context of the role (Select OrganizationAffiliations associated with the specified specialty)

params.name: location
params.description: The location(s) at which the role occurs (Select OrganizationAffiliations available at the specified location)

params.name: network
params.description:
Health insurance provider network in which the `participatingOrganization`
provides the role's services (if defined) at the indicated locations (if
defined) (Select roles where the organization is a member of the specified
health insurance provider network)

params.name: participating-organization
params.description: The organization that provides services to the primary organization (Select roles filled by the specified organization)

params.name: primary-organization
params.description: The organization that receives the services from the `participating organization` (Select roles offered by the specified organization)

params.name: endpoint
params.description: Technical endpoints providing access to services operated for this role (Select OrganizationAffiliations with the specified endpoint)

params.name: service
params.description: Healthcare services provided through the role (Select OrganizationAffiliations providing the specified service)

params.name: _profile
params.description: Select resources based on a given HL7 profile.

params.name: _id
params.description: Select resource based on the logical `id`.

params.name: _lastUpdated
params.description:
Select resources based on the last time they were changed.

- Only date is supported in `yyyy-mm-dd` format.
- Prefixes supported are `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge` and `le`. Refer to their definitions at http://hl7.org/fhir/search.html#prefix.

eg: `_lastUpdated=eq2021-01-14`

params.name: id
params.description: Fetch a resource using its logical `id`.
